vibe._comment: One VibeAI invocation = one manager.handle_user_request() call via scripts/vibeloop_run_one.py (cli.py is an interactive REPL, no headless single-prompt mode). Answer is read from --out, not stdout, so loguru's stderr logging never contaminates it.
vibe._config_path_comment: The mutable surface: 6 hot system prompts (config/scaffold_loader.py), extracted from what were Python string constants in manager/claude_manager.py, teams/code.py, teams/brain.py, teams/router_team.py. This is the ONLY file the loop may rewrite.

eval._comment: repeats:1 by design, not the usual 2-floor recommendation -- loop-tester's own escalation policy (see .claude/agents/loop-tester.md) re-runs at 2-3 repeats only when a delta lands near the promotion boundary, so paying for repeats up front on every candidate would duplicate what that gate already does cheaper.

budget._spend_ceiling_comment: No max_total_calls/max_total_tokens yet -- set these after seeing iteration-0's actual spend (budget.py spend status), not as a guess before any real number exists.

mutation._comment: Only system_prompts actually exists as a rewritable surface right now -- routing policy, council parameters, and verifier thresholds are still Python constants, not config, so listing them as allowed would let scaffold-mutator believe it can touch something it can't.
